svg.text: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणा: प्रकृतिसम्भवा: । निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥
sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛti-sambhavāḥ / nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyaya
Goodness, passion, and ignorance — born of material nature — bind the eternal embodied self within the body.
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
